comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
Add Attribute success rate increased by 5%.
Several Mysterious Aether Charms can be used per one Add Attribute.

14R=>15R: Base rate 20%
You can raise success rate up to 80% by using 16 X Mysterious A. charms at a time. So You can reach 100% rate.

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body: Are those Aether Charms tradeble, can i craft them with one toon and use them with another?

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
Aether Glyph and Aether Charm are different item.

Aether Glyph is for obtainig and ranking up Attribute Tech. You can craft and trade with other players in game.

But when you use Aether Glyph, there exists success rate to rank up your Attribute Tech.

For example)
0R=> 1R, 1R=>2R, 2R=>3R
You can raise your Attribute Rank 100% chance, however 3R=>4R won't be 100% anymore. Finally 14R=>15R base rate will be 20%.

Mysterious Aether Charm can raise this base rate. A charm can raise 5% up , and you can use multiple at a time which means you can raise the success rate +80% if you have enough charms and want to do.

This item is tradable among users, came from Cove, which means UWC item.

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: Yes you can buy Aether Glyphs and Aether Charms from other players and use them to your toon.

comments.body: Available from Emergency Ganador reward shop until 9/27 maintenance. You can purchase 10 of these for 5,000 Ganador Coins each. Cheers.
